messages:
olivia: Drafting customer-facing status update for yesterday's outage. Trying to keep it concise but transparent. PTAL - I've attached a short summary and a question about RCA sharing policy.

kevin: thanks, looking now. main thing: avoid technical jargon on statuspage; link to full postmortem instead of embedding details.

maya: We should confirm legal on whether we can share timeline with partner names. @sarah do you know?

sarah: legal OK with redacted timeline, but no customer-identifying details. happy to review final.

olivia: Got it — current draft: "We experienced degraded API availability between 03:12–03:45 UTC due to a routing misconfiguration; most customers saw service restored within the window. We're publishing a full postmortem and remediation plan." Thoughts?

kevin: language OK. Suggest add a short line on mitigations already applied and the high-level next steps (owner + ETA).

olivia: proposed line:

```
Mitigations: traffic was rerouted and the routing rule corrected; automated health checks were tightened.
Next steps: canary rollout of the fix across regions (owner: raj, ETA: 72h), add unit checks to deploy pipeline (owner: evan, ETA: 2 weeks).
```

raj: can take canary rollout, starting now. I'll post progress updates in #incidents-canary. ETA 48h if no regressions.

evan: i'll scope the pipeline checks — aiming for a PR by next Tue.

maya: also flagging recurring pattern: we've had two routing-related regressions in last 6 months. Suggest we add a repeatable detection and runbook item. owner: platform-team, owner lead: kevin.

kevin: agreed — will create a small project. suggest we include that commitment in the external note: "We're investigating root causes across our deployment processes to prevent recurrence." Keep it high-level.

olivia: question about RCA sharing: do we publish full RCA publicly, or send to impacted customers and keep internal RCA for internal use only?

sarah: policy: external RCA for broad outages that affect many customers — redact PII and internal logs. For smaller impact or security-sensitive details, we do private customer-specific RCAs under NDA. I'll put a checklist together.

olivia: ok added: "A redacted RCA will be posted within 72 hours; we will notify impacted customers directly with more detail as appropriate." Anyone object?

kevin: fine. Make the 72h a target, not a hard SLA. Maybe say "targeted within 72 hours".

olivia: updated line to "targeted within 72 hours; we'll update the status page with the link when available." Thanks.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem action items created in Jira: INFR-3421, INFR-3422, INFR-3423. Owners: raj, evan, kevin. Due dates set per comments.

maya: can someone add a follow-up check in 30 days to verify mitigations? owner: kevin.

kevin: added 30d follow-up to INFR-3423. I'll schedule in calendar and add to the postmortem doc.

olivia: great — I'll finalize the statuspage copy and send a customer-facing email draft to @sarah and @kevin for review. Posting final here when done. :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks, Olivia. quick note — include a short link to our status history page and avoid using "outage" if less than 5% customers were impacted; prefer "degraded availability".

olivia: noted, will use "degraded availability". Posting final now.

olivia: [final statuspage copy pasted]

olivia: "At 03:12 UTC we detected degraded API availability due to a routing configuration error affecting a subset of customers. Service was restored by 03:45 UTC. We have applied mitigations and are publishing a redacted RCA; a targeted redacted RCA will be available within 72 hours. Impacted customers will be contacted directly with additional details."
